text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* A general assembly of the main pilots' union voted overwhelmingly on Thursday night to resume a selective strike of state carrier TAP-Air Portugal from Saturday.
* The cabinet on Thursday approved a law authorising the privatisation of a further 26 percent of the capital of Portugal Telecom.
* Ship repairer Setenave to undergo capital restructuring before privatisation.
* Retail group Sonae will invest 58 billion escudos in 250 new stores, in Portugal, Spain and Britain.

* European Commission forecasts that EU funds to be received by Portugal before 1999 will add 0.7 percent to Portugal's annual GDP growth. Portugal per capita GDP seen at 74 percent of EU average in year 2000.
